item.title: Stream Retrospective 2025
item.author: example@test.com (Mongoose Studios)
item.description:
1. Wowsers, a year!

January marks the one-year anniversary of me streaming. I didn’t actually record the first date I streamed anywhere, but as far as I can tell based on other data points it was sometime in the first few weeks of January. So I’m going to just go with January as the origin of the stream.

This is actually completely by coincidence, because I don’t believe in new years resolutions. I believe in starting that thing you want to do right now, whatever it is. There’s no time like the present to make meaningful progress toward that thing. It just so happened that I got all the pieces together and assembled the necessary skills, knowledge, and abilities to make a halfway informed attempt at running a stream around that time.

item.title: State of the Studio, 2025 Edition
item.author: example@test.com (Mongoose Studios)
item.description:
1. Wowsers, a year!

I started setting things up for the channel in December of last year. I didn’t actually start streaming until mid-January but December is where the idea started to become reality. So let’s talk about the state of Studios.

This might be a little confusing to people that aren’t me, so let me clarify real quick.

Mongoose Studios is a vehicle for my ideas/ventures/brand. Streaming is one thing that Mongoose Studios does. Software development is another thing that I do, even if a lot of it is on stream. If I were to branch out into anything else I would try to bring it under the Mongoose Studios brand in some way that made sense.
